notes.title: State of TFTC
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings treasure hunters![/h3]

[b]I want to thank you all who are supporting this project, it keeps me motivated to continue to work on Tales From The Cache![/b]

[previewyoutube=WPRE6fX8-To;full][/previewyoutube] So as you all know Summer is the best time in the year (that's debatable to some!), but on hot days it's hard to work when the weather is inviting to go outside and explore nature, get some fresh ideas for the game.
During the Summer TFTC development is slowed down tremendously, but in Autumn/Winter time it will get back to the normal development cycle.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/828235138063532082/961721129351938109/velnio_duobe.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]The Devil's Pit (Velnio duobė)[/i]
[/list]
I want to share with you all what I've been working on, from a graphics perspective the forest and the whole biome were revamped and upgraded to fit the geo location of Lithuania (this is where the game map is based), and new places to search/explore and find new caches.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LxbuutlTltD5jRrm4F/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]Sigma complex[/i]
[/list]
New puzzles to solve (improved previous ones). Game-breaking bugs also were addressed. For the 1.0.0.5 update I'been working on 3 new locations on the map, abandoned Sigma relaxation complex, Kaunas VIII fort, and Devil's Pit they all have been inspired by real-life locations and it has some resemblance to real ones.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/eQwazHCJLH2jQO6M5X/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]Simon says cache[/i]
[/list]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/828235138063532082/952550983664287874/Birdhouse_02.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]Work in progress birdhouse cache[/i]
[/list]

Have a wonderful summer!

notes.title: Early Access update 1: performance improvements, bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40402826/a7ed71c3bee364c1fe5db5ec37b83a5eebc74206.png[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] FOV slider was added and active.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Scene lighting performance.
[*]Morse ammo can puzzle visual update for better readability.
[*]Deleted floating foliage in some areas.
[*]Some stump collisions were updated.
[*]Warning boundary adjusted to 150 units. The previous boundaries check was off.
[*] Motorcycle "Lynx" has been temporarily removed.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Morse ammo can no longer be stuck on screen when the main menu opened and closed.
[*]Inspecting items from inventory no longer leaves the player unable to move.
[*]Many small fixes.
[/list]
